messages.subject: Quote from Odlewnia Kalwisz Sp. z o.o.: Kalwisz: bearing brackets in red
messages.body:
Hello,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. We are very eager to work with you and to prove ourselves as a great long-term partner for your business!

We are happy to present our offer for a price of €47.00 per unit, along with a quality commitment of 6400 ppm. 

Please note that this offer stays valid for 30 days. We remain flexible and look forward to hearing from you soon so we can start building a strong partnership together.

Kind regards
Marek Lis

messages.subject: Bearing bracket HN (part:310020): revised packages for 2027
messages.body:
Dear Mr Lis,

Thank you for confirming the 1500 ppm target. It is a good basis for the binding improvement plan our escalation letter asks for.

The forecast for part:310020 increased by 20% (fc:310020@2026-09); please reflect this additional business in your price.

This is a firm 12-month contract for 15900 pieces per year at the agreed payment terms. That gives your plant and your bank steady, plannable volume. The attached packages also include a variant with a tighter ppm commitment.

Which quality measures in your improvement plan could support the tighter target? Is there a cheaper process or packaging variant you could propose for this part?

Kind regards
Hollerau Pumpenwerke, Purchasing

messages.subject: Bearing bracket HN (part:310020) - updated packages
messages.body:
Dear Mr Lis,

Thank you for the 8D report and for committing to 800 ppm. We have built our lead package around that commitment.

PPI-D351 fell from 140.5 (idx:PPI-D351@2025-11) to 123.7 (idx:PPI-D351@2026-04), a change of -11.96%.

The attached packages cover 15900 pieces per year over a 12-month contract. This gives your plant steady, plannable volume and lets your containment and corrective actions run on a stable schedule. A variant at 300 ppm is included if your corrective actions support it.

What is the lowest price at which you can sign these terms today?

Kind regards
Hollerau Pumpenwerke, Purchasing

messages.from_name: Export Manager, Odlewnia Kalwisz Sp. z o.o.
messages.subject: Re: Bearing bracket HN (part:310020) - updated packages
messages.body:
Hello,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. Our current Angebot is a price of €46.50 per unit, a quality commitment of 300 ppm, a chargeback of €0.00 per complaint. 

As an alternative, I can offer €46.00 for the 800 ppm package to keep things moving: a price of €46.00 per unit, a quality commitment of 800 ppm, a chargeback of €0.00 per complaint.

As to the index change data you cited, we see your figures, but we cannot give up margin right now. Faster payment would help us more than anything. We checked the index data you cited; it holds and we took it into account, but it barely moves our actual costs. If you want a better price, we really need faster payment terms to help with our cash flow. Our margin and our limits stay internal. Our price follows our main cost drivers: LCI-C, PPI-C241, PPI-D351. Our standard Zahlungsziel is 60 days net. Faster payment is welcome; we can reflect it in the price. This offer is valid for 30 days.

Kind regards
Marek Lis
Export Manager, Odlewnia Kalwisz Sp. z o.o.

messages.subject: Bearing bracket HN (part:310020) - packages at 800 ppm and 300 ppm
messages.body:
Dear Mr Lis,

Thank you for the 300 ppm and 800 ppm options. Our lead package keeps the 800 ppm commitment from your 8D report.

Your previous scorecard records on-time delivery of 78% (sc:70140@2026Q2).

On cash: our current contract ctr:4600070140 runs on 90 payment days. These packages pay at 60 days, so your invoices are settled a month earlier than today. That supports your cash flow without changing your margin structure.

Both packages cover 15900 pieces per year over a 12-month contract. Volume is steady and plannable while your corrective actions take effect.

Could you also confirm the earliest lead time you can hold over the holiday shutdown?

Kind regards
Hollerau Pumpenwerke, Purchasing
